summary.text: Yes. You need a CHAS, Pioneer Generation, or Merdeka Generation card, and must be enrolled with a Healthier SG GP clinic.

details.heading: Who is eligible
details.body: You need to be a CHAS, Pioneer Generation, or Merdeka Generation cardholder. You must also be enrolled with a Healthier SG GP clinic.

example_phrasings: Do I need a CHAS card for the Healthier SG Chronic Tier?
Can I get the Healthier SG Chronic Tier without CHAS?
Do I need CHAS, PG, or MG for the Chronic Tier?

sources.page_title: Do I need to be a Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS) cardholder to enjoy the Healthier SG Chronic Tier under Healthier SG from 2024?

quotes.text: You will need to be a CHAS/ Pioneer Generation (PG)/ Merdeka Generation (MG) cardholder and be enrolled with a Healthier SG GP clinic to be eligible for the Healthier SG Chronic Tier.
